Computed the signed integral Morse boundary by recursion on every critical 6-face and obtained all 39 coefficients zero. Therefore CW model is S5 with 39 six-cells attached by zero degree; Hurewicz π5(S5)=Z makes the wedge integral, not merely rational ranks. Separately enumerated all 5616 projectively normalized invertible 3×3 F3 matrices, classified their thirteen-point permutations, enumerated invariant cycle unions, and reproduced each of 8 class multiplicities and H6 traces: 1:39,117:−1,104:3,936:−1,702:−1,624:0,1404:1,1728:0. Summed character=0. PGL3(F3)=SL3(F3) perfect makes integral H5 rank-one action trivial; finite-group rational averaging gives quotient Q in degree 5 only. The independent check script used distinct source construction and is finite/exhaustive, appropriate because the theorem concerns only PG(2,3).
